book.title: The Theory of Island Biogeography
book.author: Robert H. MacArthur and Edward O. Wilson

predict.question: You count 20 species on a small island. Each step, 3 new species arrive and 3 are lost. After four steps, how many species do you count?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Island species numbers reflect both immigration and extinction.
modelBoundary: Balanced flows retain {A} and {B}. Equal arrivals and losses stop net change at either stock; fixed flows do not select a unique equilibrium.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Counts and rates are stipulated. Species-dependent curves and empirical island predictions are not modeled.
